##### Project general facts

Zenith Residences by Amber Developments is a contemporary residential tower designed as a bold architectural landmark for its neighbourhood, offering sweeping views of the city skyline. The tower rises above a basement, a ground floor and a three-level podium to fourteen residential floors and a rooftop. The project offers studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments, together with retail units at ground level, designed for professionals, couples and families seeking elegant yet practical homes.

A comprehensive set of amenities supports wellbeing, recreation and relaxation. Residents can enjoy an infinity pool, a cabana deck, a jacuzzi and an ice bath, together with a gym, an indoor yoga studio and steam and sauna rooms. A co-working space, a gaming area, a multipurpose hall and the Amber Lounge create places to work and socialise, while a kids' pool, a kids' splash area, an indoor kids' play area, a barbecue area, a zen garden, a jogging track and electric vehicle charging complete the offer.

Each apartment is thoughtfully planned with private balconies, spacious layouts and contemporary finishes. Interiors are designed to maximise light, space and function, with high ceilings and a neutral colour palette that invites personal style. Kitchens are fitted with quality appliances, and bathrooms feature modern fixtures. Homes are delivered fully furnished, allowing residents to move in with ease and enjoy a comfortable, well-connected lifestyle from the very first day.

##### Location description and benefits

International City is a large residential and commercial community in the east of Dubai, and Warsan is one of its fastest-growing neighbourhoods. The area combines apartment buildings, retail, restaurants and parks with everyday services, offering a calmer suburban pace of life within easy reach of the city centre and the airport, with schools, clinics and supermarkets close to home for families and professionals.

Emirates Road is directly accessible, while Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa and Dubai International Airport are a short drive away. Dragon Mart, Dubai Silicon Oasis and Dubai Festival City are close by, and Al Awir Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road connect residents with the wider city and neighbouring emirates for daily commuting, keeping work, shopping and leisure within comfortable reach.

International City is a freehold area that attracts first-time buyers, young professionals and investors seeking accessible entry points. Strong rental demand driven by proximity to the airport, major highways and business hubs supports some of the most attractive rental yields in the city. Continued infrastructure improvements and the arrival of modern towers strengthen the long-term appeal of the area for owners and investors.
